MTA manages the blinking on the dashboard with the CAN signal
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.GearIndicationSts, according to these values:
- STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.GearIndicationSts = Normal to not active the blinking
- STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.GearIndicationSts = Blinking to active the blinking
@KeyStatus.info= keyon:
MTA shall send STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.GearIndicationSts = Blinking when:
- it detects mismatch (see the proper table in Mismatch table management depending if the scenario is
Keyon_EngineOff or Keyon_EngineOn ) after a timeout T_Gear_Mismatch.
MTA shall send STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.GearIndicationSts =Normal when:
- it doesn't detect mismatch (see the proper table in Mismatch table management depending if the scenario is
Keyon_EngineOff or Keyon_EngineOn )
MTA could require the buzzer inside with a specific signal STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.BuzzerReqSts
according to these values:
- STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.BuzzerReqSts = OFF to not active the buzzer
- STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.BuzzerReqSts = OtherCaseSoundOn to active the buzzer
@KeyStatus.info= keyon:
MTA shall send STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.BuzzerReqSts = OtherCaseSoundOn when:
- it detects mismatch (see the proper table in Mismatch table management depending if the scenario is
Keyon_EngineOff or Keyon_EngineOn ) after a timeout T_Gear_Mismatch.
MTA shall send STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.BuzzerReqSts = OFF when:
- it doesn't detect mismatch (see the proper table in Mismatch table management depending if the scenario is
Keyon_EngineOff or Keyon_EngineOn )

Else
MTA sends STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.RoboticTransmissionWarnings=
Press_Brake_Pedal_Repeat_Warning for a Tmessage
Endif

slides.title: 1.11.5 Power_Eco Management 1.11.5.1 MTA Algorithm Requirements 1.11.6 Transmission Parking Brake management 1.11.6.1 MT
slides.body:
Fiat Group Automobilies
R&D
Project: 250FL14 Ed. 4 Rev. A
14/24
*No electrical or plausability fault detected. see Diagnosis paragraph
The MTA acquires the Drive Mode Button. The button shall be managed at KeyOn (both EngineOn and EngineOff)
The Power_Eco button permits to cycle between 3 differents mode (Normal, EcoPower and PowerEco). The
Sequence of theses mode is Normal - Eco - Power - Eco.
At any startup the mode shall be Normal (that is called Predominant Mode) and the MTA sends
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.DriveModeSts=No_program_Selected.
At any keyon to keyoff transition (for the timeout T_SHOW_OFF_MTA) the MTA shall send
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.DriveModeSts=No_program_Selected.
At the first button pression (after Tdebounce) the mode switches from Normal to EcoPower and MTA sends
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.DriveModeSts=EconomyTracPlus_TowHaul.
At the next button pression (after Tdebounce) the mode switches from Eco to Power to Eco and MTA sends
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.DriveModeSts=TracPlus_TowHaulEconomy.
At the following button pressions (after Tdebounce) the MTA will change the mode follwoing the sequence Normal
- Eco - Power - Eco. At each mode the MTA shall send the proper value of
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.DriveModeSts
1.11.6.1 MTA Algorithm Requirements
1.11.6.1.1 MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq signal management
1st scenario (Switchoff):
@KeyStatus.info= keyon to keyoff transition:
If VehicleSpeed.Info (last value calculated at Keyon)<TPBM_threshold then
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Active (till the MTA is on Can Net)
Else
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Not_active and it shall send
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.RoboticTransmissionWarnings=Vehicle_In_Neutral (till the MTA is on Can
Net)
Endif
2nd scenario (+15 request or cranking request not accomplished)
@KeyStatus.info= keyoff to keyon_engineoff transition
If ShiftLeverPosition.Info*=N and BrakePedalSts.Info*= Active then
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Not_active
Elsif ShiftLeverPosition.Info*=N and BrakePedalSts.Info*= Not Active then
If TPBM_INFO.TPBMSts* != Released then
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= active
Elsif TPBM_INFO.TPBMSts*=Released then
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Not_active
Endif
Elsif ShiftLeverPosition.Info*=D or R
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= active
Endif
*(MTA shall consider the first acceptable value read after the transition of Keysts)
3rd scenario (cranking request accomplished)
@KeyStatus.info= keyoff or keyon_engineoff to keyon_engineon transition
If ShiftLeverPosition.Info*=N and BrakePedalSts.Info*= Active then
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Not_active
Endif
*(MTA shall consider the first acceptable value read after the transition of Keysts)

slides.title: Fiat Group Automobilies R&D Project: 250FL14 Ed. 4 Rev. A 15 / 24 4thscenario (le ver movement at keyon engine off. This
slides.body:
R&D
15/24
4thscenario (lever movement at keyon engine off. This scenario is active only if the 6th scenario is not active):
@KeyStatus.info= keyon_engineoff:
If MTA has accepted N (this means that MTA is in Neutral) then
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Not_active (unless what it's described in 6th scenario)
Elsif MTA has accepted D and R then
If VehicleSpeed.Info <TPBM_threshold then
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= active (Mta Shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq=active till
MTA has accepted other gears)
Else
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Not_active and it shall send
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.RoboticTransmissionWarnings=Vehicle_In_Neutral
As soon as (if MTA hasn't accepted other gears) the VehicleSpeed.Info<TPBM_threshold the MTA shall:
1) stop to send STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.RoboticTransmissionWarnings=Vehicle_In_Neutral
AND
2)MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= active.Mta Shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq=active till
MTA has accepted other gears
Endif
5th scenario (Normal operations.lever movement at keyon engine off. This scenario is active only if the 6th and 7th
scenario is not active):
@KeyStatus.info= keyon_engineon:
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Not_active (unless what it's described in 6th and 7th scenario)
6th scenario.(driver exit in N.. This scenario has priority respect 4th and 5th scenario. (driver exit)
@KeyStatus.info= keyon:
If MTA has accepted N (this means that MTA is in Neutral) then
If STATUS_B_CAN.DriverDoorSts=open OR STATUS_B_CAN2.SBR1RowDriverSeatSts =Seat Belt Not
Fasten then
If VehicleSpeed.Info <TPBM_threshold then
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= active (MTA Shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq=active
till the exit conditions are verified*)
Else
MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= Not_active and it shall send
STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.RoboticTransmissionWarnings=Vehicle_In_Neutral
As soon as (if the exit conditions are not verified*) the VehicleSpeed.Info<TPBM_threshold the MTA
shall:
1) stop to send STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.RoboticTransmissionWarnings=Vehicle_In_Neutral
AND
2)MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= active. (Mta Shall send
MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq=active till the exit conditions are verified*)
Endif
*The exit conditions from 6th scenario are verified if, in the current keycycle: MTA has recognized and accepted a
lever movement with STATUS_B_CAN.DriverDoorSts= Closed and STATUS_B_CAN2.SBR1RowDriverSeatSts
=Seat Belt fasten
7th scenario (driver exit in D/R. This scenario has priority respect 5th scenario)
@KeyStatus.info= keyon_engineon:
If MTA has accepted D/R (this means that MTA is in Drive or Reverse) then
If STATUS_B_CAN.DriverDoorSts=open AND STATUS_B_CAN2.SBR1RowDriverSeatSts =Seat Belt Not
Fasten then
If VehicleSpeed.Info <TPBM_threshold, till the exit conditions* are verified then:
1) MTA shall go to N (this creates mismatch between Lever position and Inserted Gear) AND
2) MTA shall send MOT5.Vehicle_Hold_Rq= active
Else
MTA shall continue to manage the current gear
Endif

1.13.2.1.1 ShiftLeverPosition.Info electrical diagnosis description
In the following "Detection Condition":
- Keyon
- Keyon_engineON
If MTA recognize some Electrical Fault in ShiftleverPosition, then MTA shall:
- set DTC as "validated"
- MTA shall send Motor Fault to IPC (see VF998)
- MTA shall perform this recovery:
If the fault occurs with forward gear inserted then
(MTA maintains the D till KeyStatus becomes KeyOff) AND
MTA sends STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.RoboticTransmissionWarnings=Trans_Recover_Mode_Warning
AND
MTA sends STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.ShiftLeverPosition=D
Elsif the fault occurs with R/N inserted then
MTA forces the N AND
MTA sends STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.ShiftLeverPosition=N
Elsif the fault occured in previous key cycle then
MTA forces the N AND
MTA sends STATUS_C_TCM_MTA_DCTM.ShiftLeverPosition=N
Endif
In the following "Detection Condition":
- Keyon
- Keyon_engineON
f MTA doesn't recognize any Electrical Fault in ShiftleverPosition, then MTA shall
- set DTC as "devalidated"
- MTA shall stop to send Fail to IPC (VF998)
- MTA shall consider valid the info in ShiftleverPosition.info
1.13.2.1.2 ShiftLeverPosition.Info Plausability diagnosis description
In the following "Detection Condition":
- Keyon
- Keyon_engineON
If MTA recognizes some Plausability Fault in ShiftleverPosition, then MTA shall:
- set DTC as "validated"
- MTA shall send Motor Fault to IPC (see VF998)
- MTA shall perform the recovery described in ShiftLeverPosition Electrical fault diagnosis
In the following "Detection Condition":
- Keyon
- Keyon_engineON
if MTA doesn't recognize any Plausability Fault in ShiftleverPosition, then MTA shall
- set DTC as "devalidated"
- MTA shall stop to send Fail to IPC (VF998)
- MTA shall consider valid the info in ShiftleverPosition.info
